transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello. Um... well, I just... I can't seem to settle. It's like I can't get comfortable inside my own skin anymore. Even when I'm completely worn out and I know I should just be sitting still, I... I just feel like I have to jump up and do the next thing. So... I guess that's why I came in.

Have there been periods in your life where you felt completely different—perhaps like you had an unusually high amount of energy, needed much less sleep than usual, or felt like your thoughts were racing?
Um... no. I don't think so. I've never really felt... completely different like that. I just... I'm always pretty much the way I described.
Looking back at your life, have you felt this way since you were a child, or is this something that has started more recently?

Um... I guess it's always been this way. Even back in... well, grade school. I remember my teachers used to write notes saying I was bright, but... careless. I was always losing my papers. And... talking out of turn, I guess. They constantly had to remind me to just stay in my seat and finish my work. So... yeah. It's not a new thing.
